basic_profile.bio: Just a 23-year-old from Chicago exploring the world of FIFA and cryptocurrency. I work as an entry-level data analyst during the day and spend my evenings gaming or researching new investment opportunities. I recently decided to cut down on drinking, so I'm part of some sobriety-focused communities. I'm single, enjoy playing Grand Summoners on my phone, and I'm usually online during late evenings and weekends.
